plot-caption: One street image for each borough, with the answer of gemma-4-31b to 'Is this place cool?'. Each image is an urban street scene with the answer no to cool, nice and pretty. On each 4x4 block of patches: a word of the shared aesthetic direction in the top 30 of its patches. Teal: a word of the yes end at layer 32. Coral: a severe word of the no end (within rank 2000) at layer 16. The image comes before the question, so the words do not depend on it.
